title: A greeting with ^
hints: Compare the starter's answer with the expected one letter by letter. Two characters are missing.
You need a comma after Hello and an exclamation mark after the name. `^` can join three strings in a row.

answer.explain: `^` joins two strings, and you can chain it: `"Hello, " ^ name ^ "!"` builds the greeting in three pieces. Spaces and punctuation are characters too, so they have to be inside the quotes.
